description: A cruise company can either have two types of trips, a large cruise ship or a small cruise ship. A large cruise ship trip can carry 2000 customers and produces 20 units of pollution. A small cruise ship trip can carry 800 customers and produces 15 units of pollution. There can be at most 7 large cruise ship trips and at least 40% of the total trips must be made by small cruise ships. If the cruise company aims to transport at least 20000 customers, how many of each size of cruise ships should the company use to minimize the total amount of pollution produced?

CapacityLarge.definition: Capacity of a large cruise ship in number of customers

CapacitySmall.definition: Capacity of a small cruise ship in number of customers

PollutionLarge.definition: Pollution produced by a large cruise ship trip

PollutionSmall.definition: Pollution produced by a small cruise ship trip

MaxLargeTrips.definition: Maximum number of large cruise ship trips

MinSmallTripsPercentage.definition: Minimum proportion of total trips made by small cruise ships

RequiredCustomers.definition: Required number of customers to transport

objective.description: "Minimize the total amount of pollution produced by the cruise ship trips"

constraints.description: The number of large cruise ship trips must be less than or equal to 7
At least 40% of the total trips must be made by small cruise ships
The total number of customers transported must be at least 20000
The number of large cruise ship trips must be a non-negative integer
The number of small cruise ship trips must be a non-negative integer

largeTrips.definition: Number of large cruise ship trips

smallTrips.definition: Number of small cruise ship trips
